description: Chapter gate card that lets a modern object cross worlds without a lifecycle record.

input.chapter_goal: The investigator must decide whether to use a surgical knife to preserve a sealed layer.
input.main_event: A modern surgical knife is brought into the past and used on the sealed evidence layer.
input.worsening: If the cut fails, the whole record looks contaminated; if it succeeds, the modern source becomes dangerous.
input.reader_mainline: A modern tool can only matter if its source and cost are traceable.
input.physical_operability: The surgical knife presses against the seal edge on a flat table; the cut direction follows the layer line under side light with controlled pressure.
input.next_pursuit: What does the tool's source cost in the present?
